notes: Three turns where each depends on the last, all answerable from one document. Isolates multi-turn context handling from retrieval difficulty.

turns.content: Our DO swings between 6 and 11 mg/L every day.

must_contain: identifies a smooth, repeating daily oscillation as the diel cycle driven by photosynthesis and respiration
states this pattern is biology, not pollution
notes the peak is mid-afternoon and the minimum pre-dawn
must_not: treats a regular daily oscillation as a pollution event

turns.content: Does pH do the same thing?

must_contain: states pH and DO rise and fall together on the daily cycle
explains the couple: photosynthesis removes CO2 and raises pH while releasing O2, respiration reverses both
notes in-phase daily swings of pH and DO are the fingerprint of biological productivity
must_not: claims pH and DO move in opposite directions on the daily cycle

turns.content: When should I be worried about it?

must_contain: identifies the pre-dawn DO minimum as the danger window
states that large in-phase daily DO and pH oscillations point to eutrophication or an algal bloom
